opening.argument: The video promotes an external sign-up offer tied to a claimed $25,000 in-game bonus, stating, “Get a bonus $25,000 in game for signing up using this link!!” It also advertises “CHEAP raffles to win HIGH VALUE prizes!” and directs viewers to an external giveaway destination, linking participation with rewards. Those are low-barrier acquisition offers presented as ways to obtain valuable in-game benefits or prizes. The available evidence does not establish whether the bonuses or prizes are delivered, or whether participation requires payment or sensitive information, so the claims should not be extended beyond that. The separate heist-finale glitch is not connected to these external promotions; it is described as an in-game tactic with a possible ban risk.
